# [PaginationConfig()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}

::: {.doc-subject}

:::

::: {.doc-usage-source}
Usage

[Source](https://github.com/jeffgallini/dash-mantine-datatable/blob/main/dash_mantine_datatable\__init__.py#L490-L555){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```python
PaginationConfig(**kwargs)
```
:::

## Description {.doc-description}

Build a compact pagination configuration dictionary for client-side or
server-side paging.

## Parameters {.doc-parameters}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code>[page]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | float]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Current page number in controlled pagination mode.
    Example: `page=1`.

<code>[pageSize]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | float]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Number of rows shown per page when using the `pageSize`
    prop.
    Example: `pageSize=25`.

<code>[recordsPerPage]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | float]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Preferred page-size prop matching Mantine DataTable's API.
    Example: `recordsPerPage=25`.

<code>[totalRecords]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int | float]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Total number of records available, typically required for
    server-side pagination.
    Example: `totalRecords=248`.

<code>[recordsPerPageOptions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Page-size choices shown in the footer control.
    Example: `recordsPerPageOptions=[10, 25, 50, 100]`.

<code>[pageSizeOptions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Alternative page-size options prop.
    Example: `pageSizeOptions=[10, 25, 50]`.

<code>[recordsPerPageLabel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Label shown next to the page-size selector.
    Example: `recordsPerPageLabel="Rows"`.

<code>[paginationSize]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | int | float]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Visual size of the pagination controls.
    Expected inputs: Mantine size tokens such as `'xs'`, `'sm'`, `'md'`,
    `'lg'`, `'xl'`, or a numeric size when supported.
    Example: `paginationSize="sm"`.

<code>[paginationActiveTextColor]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Text color for the active page button.
    Example: `paginationActiveTextColor="white"`.

<code>[paginationActiveBackgroundColor]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Background color for the active page button.
    Example: `paginationActiveBackgroundColor="blue.6"`.

<code>[paginationWithEdges]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Shows first/last page controls when `True`.
    Example: `paginationWithEdges=True`.

<code>[paginationWithControls]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Description: Shows previous/next controls when `True`.
    Example: `paginationWithControls=True`.
:::

## Returns {.doc-returns}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code> [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A dictionary with `None` values removed.
:::

## Notes {.doc-notes}

For most apps you will set either `recordsPerPage` or `pageSize`, not
both. This helper simply forwards whatever keys you provide.

## Examples {.doc-examples}

```python
>>> PaginationConfig(page=2, recordsPerPage=25, totalRecords=240)
{'page': 2, 'recordsPerPage': 25, 'totalRecords': 240}
```
